name: @odu/web-ui
//: THE BROWSER. Everything a person sees, and nothing a person could not: this package holds views over @odu/service-client's surface and no domain logic at all — no second retry rule, no second idea of what 'red' means, no execution path of its own. A control here is one procedure call on the same wire the CLI and the MCP face use, which is what makes the acceptance gate's 'same addressed state through every face' a property rather than a promise.
//exports: A subpath pattern: this package is BUILT, not imported. `bun scripts/build-web-ui.ts` bundles `src/main.tsx` into a dist the service serves; nothing in this tree imports it at runtime, and the map exists so the build script and the tests can reach the modules by name. Two patterns because the views are `.tsx` and the tables and types beside them are plain `.ts`.
//dependencies: Deliberately tiny. `@odu/service-client` is the contract (browser-safe by construction — see its own manifest), `solid-js` is the reactive runtime, and `effect` runs a procedure call at the UI edge. No component library and no CSS toolchain. The views are conventional Solid JSX, which needs Solid's own compiler — that is a BUILD-time toolchain, pinned in the root manifest and wired into `scripts/build-web-ui.ts` and the Nix derivation that packages the bundle, so it costs a consumer of this package nothing and is not listed here.
